summary: The Void Heart is the central pressure chamber of the Void, where collapse, entropy, and nullification converge into a single cosmic pulse. It stabilizes the Void while simultaneously threatening to tear it apart.
history: Formed during the deepest collapse of the Void.
The Heart became the stabilizing core preventing total planar implosion.
Creatures of pressure and pulse emerged from its darklight.
The Heart of the Void manifests as a cosmic guardian and destroyer.
